scientific_integrity: The all-parameters proof is symbolic; direct exhaustive computations check only finite cases. Novelty comparisons are provisional and do not establish absolute historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Only clique bouquets with at least two cliques of size at least two; the homogeneous optimum subcase is likewise restricted to q,s>=2. No result for higher attack thresholds, and no independent mathematics audit.
title: Two-attack Roman weight polynomials of clique bouquets and a sharp optimum transition
